title: NURC/SP Minimum Corpus
token_or_recording_size: 21 audio files in Minimum Corpus; parent digitized NURC/SP has 375 inquiries / 334 hours
annotation_target: audio-aligned multilevel transcripts; linguistically motivated intonation units
manual_scope: Repository explicitly calls the Minimum Corpus manually annotated; exact tier-level manual/automatic provenance and file-level annotation inventory still require verification
access: public repository metadata; dataset files via linked Portulan CLARIN record
decision_reason: Potentially qualifies under the secondary-reuse exception because the newer TaRSiLa/CORAA work contributes an isolatable manual annotation layer to legacy NURC recordings. Keep out of core until the linked corpus files are enumerated and manual versus automatic provenance is verified per tier.
evidence_summary: Authoritative repository states that the CORAA NURC-SP Minimal Corpus is a manually annotated Brazilian Portuguese spontaneous-speech subset comprising 21 audio files and audio-aligned multilevel transcripts according to linguistically motivated intonation units. Underlying recordings derive from the older NURC collection, so recording lineage must not be recounted.
